body:
This modpack is a reworked vanilla experience.

It started as a project for me and a few friends on our private server.
Now we enjoy it so much that we want to share it with the world.

It features:

    Improved visual effects

    More building blocks

    Furniture

    More wildlife

    More food options

    Cooking mechanics

    More weapons
